memory_objects.content: To ensure complete transcript coverage and prevent data loss, the system implements two specific mechanisms: 1) Segments that cross the 80-line window boundary are marked as incomplete to be merged with the subsequent chunk. 2) Any transcript lines missed during idea unit extraction are automatically added back as a raw-text idea unit with a lower quality tag.

memory_objects.content: A fundamental architectural debate exists between two models for the long-term memory system: a time-based structure where hierarchy is based on meeting chronology, versus a topic-based structure organized by semantic themes. The choice significantly impacts how revisited topics are handled, with the time-based model creating new nodes for each mention and the topic-based model updating a single evolutionary node.

memory_objects.content: Two competing architectural models for the memory hierarchy are being considered. A time-based model would structure the hierarchy based on meeting chronology, creating new L1 nodes for each mention of a topic. In contrast, a topic-based model would organize nodes by semantic themes, updating a single existing L1 node with new information and a timestamp to create an evolutionary history.

affected_objects.content: To ensure complete transcript coverage and prevent data loss, the system implements two specific mechanisms: 1) Segments that cross the 80-line window boundary are marked as incomplete to be merged with the subsequent chunk. 2) Any transcript lines missed during idea unit extraction are automatically added back as a raw-text idea unit with a lower quality tag.
A future version of the prompt is expected to include a repair mechanism that can merge low-quality, raw-text fallback units (resulting from missed lines) into adjacent, valid idea units.

The current idea unit extraction process sometimes misses transcript lines, creating 'gaps' that are captured as low-quality raw text. This is believed to be a prompt issue, and while a future prompt version is expected to include a repair mechanism to merge these gaps, this solution is not yet implemented.

To address gaps in transcript coverage, the system's prompt engineering will be updated to include a repair mechanism. This future improvement will merge 'fallback' units (raw text from missed lines) into adjacent, valid idea units.
由於系統平行地將 idea units 發送給多個專門的 agent (例如 decision agent、to-do agent)，同一個 idea unit 可能會被多個 agent 捕獲，從而產生重複的 candidate。這項設計選擇的權衡是，雖然平行處理提高了效率和專業化，但它也帶來了後續需要對重複的 candidate 進行比對、區分或合併的複雜性。
在 idea unit 切割過程中，採用了修復機制（repair mechanism）來處理不完整的片段。此機制會將零碎的語句與其上下文中最相關的部分進行合併，以確保資訊的完整性，避免遺漏。

The long-term memory model will distinguish between three key node attributes: 'Importance', a static score assigned at creation; 'Relevance', calculated dynamically during retrieval based on semantic similarity; and 'Recency' or 'Activation', a dynamic score that decays over time.
為了保存一個想法的歷史意義，應該將其靜態的「重要性」分數與處理衰減的動態「激活」參數分開。這種分離可以防止重要但陳舊的想法因時間流逝而完全消失，因為「激活」值會隨時間下降，但高重要性的項目可以有一個「底線」值。
